message.content:
London operates on **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)** during standard time (roughly late October – late March).  
During British Summer Time (BST), which runs from the last Sunday in March until the last Sunday in October, London shifts one hour ahead to **UTC+01:00**.  

So:

| Period | Local Time Zone |
|--------|------------------|
| Standard Time (winter) | GMT / UTC±0 |
| Daylight Saving (summer) | BST / UTC+1 |

If you’re looking up the exact offset right now, just check whether DST is currently active; otherwise use GMT as the base reference.
